transfer_tasks.prompt: Explain how you would adapt a study routine.
transfer_tasks.model_answer: I would adapt it by shortening each session and reviewing more often.

readings.title: The Quiet Revision
readings.text:
A learner opened the notebook after a busy day. The first plan had been too ambitious, so she decided to refine it.

She kept one short reading, one listening task, and one deliberate review. The smaller routine felt coherent, and she could finally retain what she practiced.
